messages.subject: Maple Court Care Home - factual accuracy comments (provider ID 1-AHG-MAPLE)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Hartley,

On behalf of Ashbourne Healthcare Group Limited, please find attached the provider's factual accuracy comments on the draft inspection report for Maple Court Care Home, submitted within the agreed extended deadline. Supporting records have also been uploaded to the portal.

The provider accepts the medicines omission occurred and has acted on it; the comments are confined to specific factual corrections.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP
